ScalePlatformMain.name: Mushroom scale platforms main
summary: Sprite main for the pair of mushroom platforms on the scale: the sprite is one platform and keeps its partner's position in [$1534]/[$151C] (Y lo/hi),
[state] (X lo) and [$1602] (X hi). Runs CODE_02E524 for the partner (position temporarily swapped in) and then for itself.
Whichever platform carries something sinks 8 while the other rises; if neither does, they drift toward the same height. Preserves the sprite's OAM index.

MushrmScaleTiles.name: Scale platform tile generation and balance
summary: $02E524: when on a 16 pixel row boundary and moving, generates a block under the platform (MushrmScaleTiles), draws it and runs solid-block interaction. Carry returns from InvisBlkMainRt (probably set when something stands on it).
$02E559: moves the platform vertically by A, and moves the partner's stored Y the opposite way (by -[$1491]).
Parameters: Y: table index (0 self, 2 partner); A: Y speed ($02E559).

MushroomScaleGfx.name: Draw mushroom scale platform
summary: Draws a two-tile wide mushroom top (tile $80, right half X flipped) centered on the sprite.

MovingLedgeMain.name: Moving ledge (hole) sprite main
summary: Horizontally oscillating ledge, speed +/-$10, direction flipping every $80 frames of [$1570]. Draws four tiles, tests contact with the other sprites (CODE_02E5F7, results in [$15DC,Y] and [$185C]) and Mario.

s02E666.name: Table: moving ledge tile X offsets

MovingHoleTiles.name: Moving ledge tables; Lakitu fishing line graphics
summary: $02E66A/$02E66E: tile and property tables for the moving ledge. $02E672 (from the Lakitu routine when [$151C] is set, probably the Fishin' Lakitu): draws the pole, a bait and an 8 tile line below it; touching the bait with Mario clears [$151C] and gives a score sprite (probably 1UP).

SwimJumpFishMain.name: Jumping fish sprite main
summary: Draws, locks, despawns, does Mario interaction and animation, then runs one of two states: swim back and forth, or jump out of the water.

s02E74E.name: Jumping fish state routines
summary: $02E74E, state 0: swims back and forth, flipping direction at the end of each leg (timers $40/$20), after four legs sets Y speed $A0 and goes to state 1.
$02E788, state 1: jump arc with gravity +2 until timer ends; then snaps to a 16 pixel row, returns to state 0 with a $20 frame timer.

ChucksRockMain.name: Digging Chuck's rock main
summary: Draws and updates the rock thrown by a Digging Chuck. Bounces off walls and ceiling, bounces up from the floor ($E0 or $D0 depending on fall speed) and rolls along slopes. While its timer [$1540] is under 8 it is active; with the timer running it is drawn with priority bits $10.

GrowingPipeMain.name: Growing pipe sprite main
summary: Entry for the growing pipe (CODE_02E845).

s02E835.name: Table: growing pipe Y speeds and durations
summary: DATA_02E835: Y speed per phase. DATA_02E839: phase duration in frames.

GrowingPipeTiles2.name: Growing pipe logic and right tile table
summary: $02E841: right tile table. $02E845: setup (while [$1534] is non-negative, clears one row of tiles per frame and counts down by $10), then the cycle: wait, rise, wait, sink, only while Mario is within range, generating Map16 tiles for the pipe body as it moves.

GrowingPipeGfx.name: Generate growing pipe tiles and draw top
summary: $02E8BA: generates two Map16 tiles (left, right at X+$10) at the sprite position using phase table index Y.
$02E902: draws the pipe opening as two tiles ($A4, $A6).

PipeLakituMain.name: Pipe Lakitu main
summary: Draws, and when status is 2 (killed) shows frame 2 only. Otherwise runs the state machine in PipeLakituPtrs.

PipeLakituPtrs.name: Pipe Lakitu state routines
summary: State 0: waits until Mario is away from the pipe. 1: rises, faces Mario. 2: rises further. 3: throws a sprite (spawns $14, or $21 coin with Silver POW). 4: sinks back and returns to state 0. Timer in [$1540].
